{{Top}}
The '''Expansionist Oligarchy''' was a cadre of mega-corporations granted the right to administer the [[Outer Expansion Zone/Legends|Outer Expansion Zone]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] around [[719 BBY/Legends|719 BBY]]. Given a free hand, the Oligarchy ravaged dozens of systems and reduced the workers it had imported to near-serfdom; the ensuing civil unrest forced the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] to intervene and end the [[Outer Expansion Zone scandal|experiment]].
